title: Dango configuration
description: Dango's config.json, kept in ~/.config/dango and shared over git. Every setting is optional; anything omitted uses its built-in default. Unknown keys are preserved, so a newer Dango or a plugin can add to this file safely.

extensions.description: Per-extension settings, keyed by extension id such as dango.clipboard.

hyperkey.description: A physical key remapped to act as the hyper modifier system-wide. Present means on; omit the block to turn it off.

key.description: The physical key to remap. Defaults to capslock.

shift.description: Whether Shift is part of the combination. Defaults to true; false emits Ctrl+Alt+Super, leaving typed characters unshifted.

tap.description: A key to send on a quick, solitary tap of the hyperkey, such as "escape". A hold, or a press combined with another key, still acts as the hyper modifier. Absent means a tap does nothing.

hotkey.description: A chord, either a portable string like "mod+shift+k" or a per-platform object. Modifiers: mod (Cmd on macOS, Ctrl on Windows), ctrl, alt, shift, meta, hyper. The key is a physical position such as space, k, or left.

enabled.description: Whether the extension runs. Absent means enabled.

preferences.description: The extension's preference values, overriding its declared defaults.

commands.description: Per-command settings, keyed by command id.

apps.description: Applications bound to global hotkeys, keyed by the name Dango shows for the application in root search. Read by dango.applications only.

name.description: The application's shown name when it differs from the key, either one string or a per-platform object. An object with no value for the running platform means the entry is skipped there.

alias.description: A short alias that matches this command in root search.
